paragraphs: A patient-first map of the Australian healthcare system. Sibling venture of ADHD.ME under Wattle Technologies.

Status (2026-10-16): Queensland MVP running on real data. 4,736 doctors nationally (psychiatry, obstetrics-gynaecology, paediatrics) from 12 public sources; 876 in Queensland; 195 Queensland doctors linked to 1,077 verified publications. Patient journey and clinician onboarding implemented to the Figma design (file NEbiukDE3TyWFptwaCBhwV), 19 screens, two-layer matching ported from ADHD.ME (600 tests). Supabase project wattle-health (ap-southeast-2) holds the same data behind published views.

v7 (2026-10-18): Zocdoc's guided questions, recovered with REA (morluto/rea) from the shipped SearchAI bundle in the Wayback archive (qa/benchmark-zocdoc/archive), rebuilt one question per screen with progress, Back and "Just show my matches": specific issue, experience with care, type of care, medication management, open to a GP (excludes GPs on "no"), who it's for, age, video or in person, plus Wattle's "what matters most", then "Here's what you'll be searching for". No insurance. Verified patient reviews on every profile: average, count, "Highly recommended by Wattle patients" at 3+…

whatItDoes.text: A patient-first map of the Australian healthcare system. Sibling venture of ADHD.ME under Wattle Technologies.

requirements.text: To get a public production URL: create a wattle-health Vercel project linked to this repo (the MCP token cannot; npx vercel login then vercel link), add the env from .env.production, and SUPABASESERVICEROLEKEY for clinician writes.
